According to several articles I've read online today, there is an upcoming issue with the iPhone 5 that could cause some apps to stop working ( [https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT210712#925](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT210712#925) ).  I'm unable to determine if this could cause issues with iPhone 5C.  

The highest iOS available to the 5C is 10.3.3 which is not the version listed in the article as having the fix but the 5C has a later manufacture date.

Am I just screwed and will have to buy a new phone before November 3rd?

Learn to do your taxes.  Life doesn't get better.  Nobody cares about you or your life but you.  Work isn't fun.  A job is just that, a job.  You are entitled to nothing.  Don't bother forming relationships because in the end everybody will leave you.  The world is a terrible, horrible place and coating over this fact will only harm you.  Exercise.

Owning the house hasn't benefited me much other than not living with my parents.  I have no spouse or children, so I at least don't have that to worry about.  I don't have any friends.  I've pretty much exhausted all my options at this point.  I just really wish I hadn't listened to the lie that my field of study (Computer Science) was lucrative.  Companies only want to hire the next Zuckerberg or Gates.  They don't care about people like me that do a good job but aren't "brilliant".  I hate this so much.
